imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0+nre6 - statement of changes

This wheel is built from imageio-ffmpeg (https://github.com/imageio/imageio-ffmpeg, BSD 2-Clause) at
tag v0.6.0. It bundles an LGPL-2.1-or-later FFmpeg 9.0.1 executable and SVT-AV1 2.3.0; their
source tarballs ship inside the wheel under imageio_ffmpeg/binaries/. The files below were modified
by NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, 2026.

Changes applied by the NuRec build:
- imageio_ffmpeg/binaries/: the upstream FFmpeg executable is replaced by the NVIDIA build named
  ffmpeg-linux-<arch>-v9.0.1, with LICENSE.ffmpeg-LGPL, BUILD-INFO.txt, the FFmpeg and SVT-AV1
  source tarballs and a CycloneDX record of the FFmpeg component.
- imageio_ffmpeg/_definitions.py: __version__ = "0.6.0+nre6"; the per-platform executable names
  point at v9.0.1.
- imageio_ffmpeg/__init__.py: imports the codec helpers from the added _video_codec.py
  (ensure_nvenc_available, get_codec_config, is_nvenc_available, pick_codec).
- imageio_ffmpeg/_video_codec.py and py.typed: added.
